2608.18884.title: Training-Free Inference-Time Self-Reflection and Cost-Bounded Early Stopping for Large Language Models
2608.18884.paper_summary: Reinforcement-learning training of reasoning LLMs (e.g., GRPO) is expensive and requires a controllable environment, committing every contribution to a full training pipeline. We present EvoResearcher, a training-free, inference-time protocol that adds cost-bounded self-reflection to a single frozen LLM backbone. The protocol iterates generate -> self-critique -> revise until a maximum depth D is reached or the critique returns the CONFIRMED sentinel, an implicit early stop that lets the backbone self-verify its answer under a strict compute budget. Four self-reflective meta-reward components (correctness, efficiency, reflection depth, tool-call diversity) act as design principles instantiated as prompt-level mechanisms, so their benefits accrue with zero gradient updates. We validate the protocol on Big-Bench Hard (100 questions) and establish cross-domain behavior on GSM8K (500) and MATH (500) on the same frozen backbone, with cross-model replication on Qwen2.5-72B. All experiments use pure-reasoning benchmarks; the tool-call diversity component is validated in prompt-level form, and the environment-level and multi-agent extensions are design blueprints left to future work. On clean BBH the protocol does not raise accuracy beyond the 95% Wilson interval; its value is cost-bounded self-verification, with the CONFIRMED early stop terminating 82-88% of items at equal accuracy (about 2.1 generations per question).
2608.18884.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習訓練推理 LLM（例如 GRPO）成本高昂，並且需要可控環境，將每一項貢獻都納入完整的訓練流程中。<lb/>我們提出 EvoResearcher，一種無需訓練的推理時協議，為單一的凍結 LLM 主幹增加了成本受限的自我反思。<lb/>該協議重複進行生成 -> 自我批評 -> 修訂，直到達到最大深度 D 或批評返回 CONFIRMED 哨兵，這是一種隱式的早期停止，讓主幹在嚴格的計算預算下自我驗證其答案。<lb/>四個自我反思的元獎勵組件（正確性、效率、反思深度、工具調用多樣性）作為設計原則實現為提示級機制，因此它們的好處在沒有任何梯度更新的情況下累積。<lb/>我們在 Big-Bench Hard（100 個問題）上驗證了該協議，並在相同的凍結主幹上建立了在 GSM8K（500）和 MATH（500）上的跨領域行為，並在 Qwen2.5-72B 上進行了跨模型複製。<lb/>所有實驗均使用純推理基準；工具調用多樣性組件以提示級形式進行驗證，而環境級和多代理擴展則是留待未來工作的設計藍圖。<lb/>在乾淨的 BBH 上，該協議的準確率並未超過 95% 的威爾遜區間；其價值在於成本受限的自我驗證，CONFIRMED 早期停止在相同準確率下終止了 82-88% 的項目（每個問題約 2.1 次生成）。
